import zipfile, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p = '"'$TMPDIR/gj_college_list1.bin'"'
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    ns={'m':'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
    ss=[x.text or '' for x in ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml')).findall('m:si',ns)]
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    for row in root.findall('.//m:row',ns):
        vals=[]
        for c in row.findall('m:c',ns):
            v=c.find('m:v',ns)
            vals.append(ss[int(v.text)] if v is not None and c.get('t')=='s' else (v.text if v is not None else ''))
        if any('CHITRANGI' in x.upper() or 'SINGRAULI' in x.upper() for x in vals): print(vals)
PY"
